name: Sea Monarch
description: (Tag:vitality+)(Tag:water)(Tag:water+)(Tag:water-resistance+)You are the Sea Monarch, ruler of all Water and the depths; your vitality is massively increased, as the sea is the mother of all life. All your water-related abilities below Mythical Tier are increased by one rank and cost less energy. All water and sea-aligned beings instinctively recognize you as Monarch, and you are immune to water and ice-based abilities.
